definitions: A common parting phrase used to express a wish for someone's continued well-being and security, especially in situations that might involve potential risks or dangers.
An expression of concern and care, encouraging someone to take precautions and avoid harm.
examples: It was great seeing you, stay safe on your drive home!
The weather looks rough, stay safe out there.
We'll miss you at the conference, stay safe and healthy.
Before you go hiking, remember to pack essentials and stay safe.
